verses.original: אַל־ תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאַנְשֵׁ֣י רָעָ֑ה וְאַל־ תִּתְאָו לִהְי֥וֹת אִתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·qan·nê bə·’an·šê rā·‘āh wə·’al- tiṯ·ʾå̄w lih·yō·wṯ ’it·tām
verses.literal: Do not envy wicked . . . men or desire their company . . .

verses.original: כִּי־ שֹׁ֭ד יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לִבָּ֑ם וְ֝עָמָ֗ל שִׂפְתֵיהֶ֥ם תְּדַבֵּֽרְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- šōḏ yeh·geh lib·bām wə·‘ā·māl śip̄·ṯê·hem tə·ḏab·bê·rə·nāh
verses.literal: for their hearts devise violence and their lips declare trouble

verses.original: בְּ֭חָכְמָה יִבָּ֣נֶה בָּ֑יִת וּ֝בִתְבוּנָ֗ה יִתְכּוֹנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥā·ḵə·māh yib·bā·neh bā·yiṯ ū·ḇiṯ·ḇū·nāh yiṯ·kō·w·nān
verses.literal: By wisdom a house is built and by understanding it is established

verses.original: וּ֭בְדַעַת חֲדָרִ֣ים יִמָּלְא֑וּ כָּל־ ה֖וֹן יָקָ֣ר וְנָעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḏa·‘aṯ ḥă·ḏā·rîm yim·mā·lə·’ū kāl- hō·wn yā·qār wə·nā·‘îm
verses.literal: through knowledge its rooms are filled with every precious and beautiful treasure

verses.original: גֶּֽבֶר־ חָכָ֥ם בַּע֑וֹז וְאִֽישׁ־ דַּ֝֗עַת מְאַמֶּץ־ כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ge·ḇer- ḥā·ḵām ba·‘ō·wz wə·’îš- da·‘aṯ mə·’am·meṣ- kō·aḥ
verses.literal: A wise man is strong and a man of knowledge enhances his strength

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְ֭תַחְבֻּלוֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֣ מִלְחָמָ֑ה וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇə·ṯaḥ·bu·lō·wṯ ta·‘ă·śeh- lə·ḵā mil·ḥā·māh ū·ṯə·šū·‘āh bə·rōḇ yō·w·‘êṣ
verses.literal: Only with sound guidance should you wage war and victory lies in a multitude of counselors

verses.original: רָאמ֣וֹת לֶֽאֱוִ֣יל חָכְמ֑וֹת בַּ֝שַּׁ֗עַר לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח־ פִּֽיהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: rā·mō·wṯ le·’ĕ·wîl ḥā·ḵə·mō·wṯ baš·ša·‘ar lō yip̄·taḥ- pî·hū
verses.literal: Wisdom is too high for a fool he does not open his mouth in the meeting place

verses.original: מְחַשֵּׁ֥ב לְהָרֵ֑עַ ל֝֗וֹ בַּֽעַל־ מְזִמּ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ḥaš·šêḇ lə·hā·rê·a‘ lōw ba·‘al- mə·zim·mō·wṯ yiq·rā·’ū
verses.literal: He who plots evil will be called a schemer . . .

verses.original: זִמַּ֣ת אִוֶּ֣לֶת חַטָּ֑את וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת לְאָדָ֣ם לֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: zim·maṯ ’iw·we·leṯ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ lə·’ā·ḏām lêṣ
verses.literal: A foolish scheme is sin and a mocker is detestable to men

verses.original: הִ֭תְרַפִּיתָ בְּי֥וֹם צָרָ֗ה צַ֣ר כֹּחֶֽכָה׃
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·rap·pî·ṯā bə·yō·wm ṣā·rāh ṣar kō·ḥe·ḵāh
verses.literal: If you faint in the day of distress how small is your strength

verses.original: הַ֭צֵּל לְקֻחִ֣ים לַמָּ֑וֶת וּמָטִ֥ים לַ֝הֶ֗רֶג אִם־ תַּחְשֽׂוֹךְ׃
verses.transliteration: haṣ·ṣêl lə·qu·ḥîm lam·mā·weṯ ū·mā·ṭîm la·he·reḡ ’im- taḥ·śō·wḵ
verses.literal: Rescue those being led away to death and restrain those stumbling toward the slaughter . . .

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תֹאמַ֗ר הֵן֮ לֹא־ יָדַ֪עְנ֫וּ זֶ֥ה הֲ‍ֽלֹא־ תֹ֘כֵ֤ן לִבּ֨וֹת׀ הֽוּא־ יָבִ֗ין וְנֹצֵ֣ר נַ֭פְשְׁךָ ה֣וּא יֵדָ֑ע וְהֵשִׁ֖יב לְאָדָ֣ם כְּפָעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯō·mar hên lō- yā·ḏa‘·nū zeh hălō- ṯō·ḵên lib·bō·wṯ hū- yā·ḇîn wə·nō·ṣêr nap̄·šə·ḵā hū yê·ḏā‘ wə·hê·šîḇ lə·’ā·ḏām kə·p̄ā·‘o·lōw
verses.literal: If you say Behold we did not know about this does not He who weighs hearts consider it Does not the One who guards your life know Will He not repay a man according to his deeds

verses.original: אֱכָל־ בְּנִ֣י דְבַ֣שׁ כִּי־ ט֑וֹב וְנֹ֥פֶת מָ֝ת֗וֹק עַל־ חִכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḵāl- bə·nî ḏə·ḇaš kî- ṭō·wḇ wə·nō·p̄eṯ mā·ṯō·wq ‘al- ḥik·ke·ḵā
verses.literal: Eat honey my son for it is good and the honeycomb is sweet to your taste

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן׀ דְּעֶ֥ה חָכְמָ֗ה לְנַ֫פְשֶׁ֥ךָ אִם־ מָ֭צָאתָ וְיֵ֣שׁ אַחֲרִ֑ית וְ֝תִקְוָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִכָּרֵֽת׃פ
verses.transliteration: kên də·‘eh ḥāḵ·māh lə·nap̄·še·ḵā ’im- mā·ṣā·ṯā wə·yêš ’a·ḥă·rîṯ wə·ṯiq·wā·ṯə·ḵā lō ṯik·kā·rêṯ
verses.literal: Know therefore that wisdom is sweet to your soul If you find it there is a future for you and your hope will never be cut off

verses.original: אַל־ תֶּאֱרֹ֣ב רָ֭שָׁע לִנְוֵ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק אַֽל־ תְּשַׁדֵּ֥ד רִבְצוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- te·’ĕ·rōḇ rā·šā‘ lin·wêh ṣad·dîq ’al- tə·šad·dêḏ riḇ·ṣō
verses.literal: Do not lie in wait O wicked man near the dwelling of the righteous do not destroy his resting place

verses.original: כִּ֤י שֶׁ֨בַע׀ יִפּ֣וֹל צַדִּ֣יק וָקָ֑ם וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ בְרָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî še·ḇa‘ yip·pō·wl ṣad·dîq wā·qām ū·rə·šā·‘îm yik·kā·šə·lū ḇə·rā·‘āh
verses.literal: For though a righteous man may fall seven times he still gets up but the wicked stumble in bad times

verses.original: בִּנְפֹ֣ל אוֹיְבֶיךָ אַל־ תִּשְׂמָ֑ח וּ֝בִכָּשְׁל֗וֹ אַל־ יָגֵ֥ל לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bin·p̄ōl ʾō·yə·ḇɛ·ḵå̄ ’al- tiś·māḥ ū·ḇik·kā·šə·lōw ’al- yā·ḡêl lib·be·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not gloat when your enemy falls and do not let your heart rejoice when he stumbles

verses.original: פֶּן־ יִרְאֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה וְרַ֣ע בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְהֵשִׁ֖יב מֵעָלָ֣יו אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: pen- yir·’eh Yah·weh wə·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nāw wə·hê·šîḇ mê·‘ā·lāw ’ap·pōw
verses.literal: or the LORD will see and disapprove . . . and turn His wrath away from him

verses.original: אַל־ תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל־ תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בָּרְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiṯ·ḥar bam·mə·rê·‘îm ’al- tə·qan·nê bā·rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: Do not fret over evildoers and do not be envious of the wicked

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ לֹֽא־ תִהְיֶ֣ה אַחֲרִ֣ית לָרָ֑ע נֵ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō- ṯih·yeh ’a·ḥă·rîṯ lā·rā‘ nêr rə·šā·‘îm yiḏ·‘āḵ
verses.literal: For the evil man has no future the lamp of the wicked will be extinguished

verses.original: יְרָֽא־ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה בְּנִ֣י וָמֶ֑לֶךְ עִם־ שׁוֹנִ֑ים אַל־ תִּתְעָרָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: yə·rā- ’eṯ- Yah·weh bə·nî wā·me·leḵ ‘i·mō·šō- šō·w·nîm ’al- tiṯ·‘ā·rāḇ
verses.literal: My son fear the LORD and the king and do not associate with the rebellious

verses.original: כִּֽי־ פִ֭תְאֹם יָק֣וּם אֵידָ֑ם וּפִ֥יד שְׁ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם מִ֣י יוֹדֵֽעַ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- p̄iṯ·’ōm yā·qūm ’ê·ḏām ū·p̄îḏ šə·nê·hem mî yō·w·ḏê·a‘
verses.literal: For they will bring sudden destruction Who knows what ruin they can bring

verses.original: גַּם־ אֵ֥לֶּה לַֽחֲכָמִ֑ים הַֽכֵּר־ פָּנִ֖ים בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט בַּל־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’êl·leh la·ḥă·ḵā·mîm hak·kêr- pā·nîm bə·miš·pāṭ bal- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: These also are sayings of the wise To show partiality . . . in judgment is not good

verses.original: אֹ֤מֵ֨ר׀ לְרָשָׁע֮ צַדִּ֪יק אָ֥תָּה יִקְּבֻ֥הוּ עַמִּ֑ים יִזְעָמ֥וּהוּ לְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·mêr lə·rā·šā‘ ṣad·dîq ’āt·tāh yiq·qə·ḇu·hū ‘am·mîm yiz·‘ā·mū·hū lə·’um·mîm
verses.literal: Whoever tells the guilty You are innocent peoples will curse him and nations will denounce him

verses.original: וְלַמּוֹכִיחִ֥ים יִנְעָ֑ם וַֽ֝עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם תָּב֥וֹא בִרְכַּת־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lam·mō·w·ḵî·ḥîm yin·‘ām wa·‘ă·lê·hem tā·ḇō·w ḇir·kaṯ- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty and rich blessing will come upon them

verses.original: שְׂפָתַ֥יִם יִשָּׁ֑ק מֵ֝שִׁ֗יב דְּבָרִ֥ים נְכֹחִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: śə·p̄ā·ṯa·yim yiš·šāq mê·šîḇ də·ḇā·rîm nə·ḵō·ḥîm
verses.literal: An honest answer given is like a kiss on the lips

verses.original: הָ֘כֵ֤ן בַּח֨וּץ׀ מְלַאכְתֶּ֗ךָ וְעַתְּדָ֣הּ בַּשָּׂדֶ֣ה לָ֑ךְ אַ֝חַ֗ר וּבָנִ֥יתָ בֵיתֶֽךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: hā·ḵên ba·ḥūṣ mə·laḵ·te·ḵā wə·‘at·tə·ḏāh baś·śā·ḏeh lāḵ ’a·ḥar ū·ḇā·nî·ṯā ḇê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Complete your outdoor work and prepare your field after that you may build your house

verses.original: אַל־ תְּהִ֣י עֵד־ חִנָּ֣ם בְּרֵעֶ֑ךָ וַ֝הֲפִתִּ֗יתָ בִּשְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·hî ‘êḏ- ḥin·nām bə·rê·‘e·ḵā wa·hă·p̄it·tî·ṯā biś·p̄ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not testify . . . against your neighbor without cause and do not deceive with your lips

verses.original: אַל־ תֹּאמַ֗ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽשָׂה־ לִ֭י כֵּ֤ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לּ֑וֹ אָשִׁ֖יב לָאִ֣ישׁ כְּפָעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tō·mar ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh- lî kên ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lōw ’ā·šîḇ lā·’îš kə·p̄ā·‘o·lōw
verses.literal: Do not say I will do to him . . . as he has done to me I will repay the man according to his work

verses.original: עַל־ שְׂדֵ֣ה אִישׁ־ עָצֵ֣ל עָבַ֑רְתִּי וְעַל־ כֶּ֝֗רֶם אָדָ֥ם חֲסַר־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- śə·ḏêh ’îš- ‘ā·ṣêl ‘ā·ḇar·tî wə·‘al- ke·rem ’ā·ḏām ḥă·sar- lêḇ
verses.literal: I went past the field of a slacker . . . and by the vineyard of a man lacking judgment

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה עָ֘לָ֤ה כֻלּ֨וֹ׀ קִמְּשֹׂנִ֗ים כָּסּ֣וּ פָנָ֣יו חֲרֻלִּ֑ים וְגֶ֖דֶר אֲבָנָ֣יו נֶהֱרָֽסָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ‘ā·lāh ḵul·lōw qim·mə·śō·nîm kās·sū p̄ā·nāw ḥă·rul·lîm wə·ḡe·ḏer ’ă·ḇā·nāw ne·hĕ·rā·sāh
verses.literal: Thorns had grown up everywhere thistles had covered the ground and the stone wall was broken down

verses.original: וָֽאֶחֱזֶ֣ה אָ֭נֹכִֽי אָשִׁ֣ית לִבִּ֑י רָ֝אִ֗יתִי לָקַ֥חְתִּי מוּסָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’e·ḥĕ·zeh ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ā·šîṯ lib·bî rā·’î·ṯî lā·qaḥ·tî mū·sār
verses.literal: I observed and took it to heart I looked and received instruction

verses.original: מְעַ֣ט שֵׁ֭נוֹת מְעַ֣ט תְּנוּמ֑וֹת מְעַ֓ט׀ חִבֻּ֖ק יָדַ֣יִם לִשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: mə·‘aṭ šē·nôt̲ mə·‘aṭ tə·nū·mō·wṯ mə·‘aṭ ḥib·buq yā·ḏa·yim liš·kāḇ
verses.literal: A little sleep a little slumber a little folding of the hands to rest

verses.original: וּבָֽא־ מִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ רֵישֶׁ֑ךָ וּ֝מַחְסֹרֶ֗יךָ כְּאִ֣ישׁ מָגֵֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā- miṯ·hal·lêḵ rê·še·ḵā ū·maḥ·sō·re·ḵā kə·’îš mā·ḡên
verses.literal: and poverty will come upon you like a robber and need like a bandit . . .
